notes.title: Patch #3 The Blast Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Just a quick patch that will fix a couple of issues that we saw popping yesterday! We hope that your saves won't be deleted this time and we are really sorry if it happens again. 

- Fix the dialogues of Blast Professor (again...)
- Fix the collision and triggers of the MagnaVex TV
- Fix Windows 7 version

We are really close to 10K units "sold" and so we want to thank you again for your support <3 We hope that Evo\Wave brought you fun and joy and that it will continue to do so!

The Evo\Wave Team

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
Hi everyone ! Today we bring you news and a patch for Evo\Wave ! 

Firstly, we want to thank you for your outstanding support for our game ! As some of you know, we are a team of students and this is our final project so it means alot for us that so many people like our game and also leave reviews, sending us messages and making videos or speedrun ! 

We also want to remind you that the soundtrack of Evo\Wave is available for free on Steam and on YouTube !! So if you liked the multiple songs of the game you can get them for free !!

We hope that with this update the Evo\Core will be more powerful and will help you in your fight against the evil MagnaVex !!

Fixes :

Fixing an issue with the power coming back offline in the level 2
Fixing the “Ok Boomer” achievement 
Improvement on the UI to make it more user friendly
Fixing duplicating Facts sheets and chips in the level 3
Fixing some dialogue issue with Bl4st Pr0fessor
Fixing some minor sound and visual bugs

Thank you all again from the bottom of our hearts - The Evo\Wave Team
